source:
@@U04130@@
Our young and tested troops
will check their progress.

@@U04132@@
Then admit this vigorous hero into your ranks,
for once he’s with you you'll see what he’s capable of.

@@U04133@@
(He points to the one on his right.)

@@U04135@@
(Stepping forward.)

@@U04136@@
Who looks me in the face, he runs the hazard
Of being well scored over cheek and mazard;
Who turns his back to me—well, he may risk it,
But down he'll topple, cleft from chin to brisket.
And if your men will only then
With sword and mace strike home like me,
Your foes amain will strew the plain,
Bathed in their blood as in a sea.

@@U04137@@
(Exit.)

@@U04139@@
Center phalanx advance at full strength,
but with caution. Over there to the right
I see we've made good headway,
upsetting the enemy’s plans.

@@U04141@@
(Pointing to the one in the middle.)

@@U04142@@
This one, too, must join your command.
He'll sweep all before him.

@@U04144@@
(Stepping forward.)

@@U04145@@
Add to the army’s blood and thunder
The all-essential lust to plunder;
Let every man make his intent
To pillage the rival emperor's tent!
He hasn't long to flaunt his pride,
As long as I the phalanx guide.
translation:
@@U04130@@
我们年轻且久经考验的部队
将检查他们的进展。

@@U04132@@
那么就接纳这位充满活力的英雄加入你的队伍吧，
一旦他和你在一起，你就会看到他的能力。

@@U04133@@
（他指着他右边的那个。）

@@U04135@@
（向前迈出一步。）

@@U04136@@
谁看着我的脸，他就冒着危险
脸颊和马扎德得分很高；
谁背对着我——好吧，他可能会冒险，
但他会倒下，从下巴到胸口裂开。
如果你的人愿意的话
像我一样用剑和狼牙棒击中目标，
你的敌人将遍布平原，
沐浴在他们的鲜血之中，如同沐浴在大海之中。

@@U04137@@
（退出。）

@@U04139@@
中锋方阵全力推进，
但要小心。那边右边
我发现我们已经取得了很好的进展
打乱敌人的计划。

@@U04141@@
（指着中间的那个。）

@@U04142@@
这个也必须加入你的指挥。
他将横扫面前的一切。

@@U04144@@
（向前迈出一步。）

@@U04145@@
为军队增添热血与雷霆
最本质的掠夺欲望；
让每个人都表达自己的意图
掠夺敌对皇帝的帐篷！
他没多久就炫耀自己的骄傲，
只要我方阵引导。
